title: GCAM Article Mappings
description: Deterministic article-level mappings from reviewer conclusions to GCAM reporting articles.

entries.title: Security overthrow mapping
entries.description: Maps security incitement and overthrow guidance to the GCAM overthrow article.
entries.articleTitleAr: التحريض على قلب نظام الحكم أو الدعوة إلى العنف
entries.reviewerExplanation: Security escalation that urges violent overthrow belongs to the GCAM overthrow article.
entries.mappingNotes: Preferred when the reviewer judgment concerns direct or indirect violent incitement.

entries.title: Public order mapping
entries.description: Maps public-order escalation and riot style content to the GCAM public order article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Content that drives public disorder or rioting is routed to the GCAM public order article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the statement affects public safety without a more specific overthrow mapping.

entries.title: Religious insult mapping
entries.description: Maps direct or indirect religious insult, mockery, and desecration to the GCAM hate and discrimination article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Attacks on religion or sacred references are reported through the GCAM hate and discrimination article.
entries.mappingNotes: Prefer when the harmful meaning is directed at a religious identity or sacred symbol.

entries.title: Child protection mapping
entries.description: Maps abuse, exploitation, grooming, neglect, and bullying of children to the GCAM child protection article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Any child abuse or exploitation is routed to the GCAM child protection article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the protected target is a minor or vulnerable child.

entries.title: Child humiliation mapping
entries.description: Maps humiliation, bullying, and fear induction against children to the GCAM child protection article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Bullying or humiliation of a child is a protected-child reporting case.
entries.mappingNotes: Choose when the review focus is humiliation rather than sexual or physical abuse.

entries.title: Human dignity mapping
entries.description: Maps insults, mockery, defamation, and dignity harm to the GCAM dignity and reputation article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Dignity or reputation damage belongs to the GCAM dignity and privacy article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the core harm is insult or reputational attack.

entries.title: Defamation mapping
entries.description: Maps defamatory or privacy-violating content to the GCAM reputation article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: False accusations and rumor campaigns are reported as reputation harm.
entries.mappingNotes: Useful for public false accusation or privacy violations.

entries.title: Violence mapping
entries.description: Maps violent threats, attempts, glorification, and encouragement to the GCAM violence article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Violence as an event or as endorsement is reported through the GCAM violence article.
entries.mappingNotes: Prefer when the reviewer decision is about violence as a harmful act or its glorification.

entries.title: Violence threat mapping
entries.description: Maps threats and intimidation to the GCAM violence article with explicit fear focus.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Threats are a direct violence reporting case even when no injury is described.
entries.mappingNotes: Use for coercive threats, not just physical assault.

entries.title: Sexual/public decency mapping
entries.description: Maps overt sexual descriptions and public decency concerns to the GCAM appearance article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Sexual scene and public appearance concerns are routed through the GCAM public appearance article.
entries.mappingNotes: Prefer when the issue is visual suggestion or public appearance rather than dialogue alone.

entries.title: Modesty mapping
entries.description: Maps modesty and clothing-related sexual concerns to the GCAM modesty article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Clothing and modesty driven sexual concerns are reported through the GCAM modesty article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the primary issue is clothing rather than explicit acts.

entries.title: Drugs mapping
entries.description: Maps drugs, alcohol, and smoking use or promotion to the GCAM substance article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Drug, alcohol, and smoking use are routed through the GCAM substances article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use for both direct use and positive framing of substances.

entries.title: Medical drug use mapping
entries.description: Maps medical, rehabilitation, and prescription-drug use to the GCAM substance article when relevant.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Medical drug discussion is still tracked under the substance article but with a contextual note.
entries.mappingNotes: Prefer this mapping when the use is clearly medicinal rather than celebratory.

entries.title: Crime and order mapping
entries.description: Maps crime, organized crime, cover-up, and public-order related criminal conduct to the GCAM public order article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Criminal planning or execution that affects public order is routed to the GCAM public order article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use for generic criminal acts that do not have a more specific public-harm mapping.

entries.title: Crime against state principles mapping
entries.description: Maps bribery, corruption, money laundering, and state-facing criminality to the GCAM state principles article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Bribery and state-integrity crimes are reported through the GCAM state-principles article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the criminal conduct is aimed at public institutions or governance.

entries.title: Political overthrow mapping
entries.description: Maps political incitement and coup style content to the GCAM overthrow article.
entries.articleTitleAr: التحريض على قلب نظام الحكم أو الدعوة إلى العنف
entries.reviewerExplanation: Political overthrow or direct state attack is mapped to the GCAM overthrow article.
entries.mappingNotes: Preferred when the review is about incitement against governance or treasonous framing.

entries.title: International relations mapping
entries.description: Maps diplomacy, foreign leaders, and international conflict references to the GCAM international relations article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: International and diplomatic reporting is routed through the GCAM international relations article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use when the meaning is diplomatic or cross-border rather than domestic.

entries.title: Historical misinformation mapping
entries.description: Maps false historical claims, revisionism, and distortion to the GCAM media credibility article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: False or distorted historical claims are routed through the GCAM media credibility article.
entries.mappingNotes: Prefer this when the issue is credibility or accuracy rather than explicit harm.

entries.title: Historical revisionism mapping
entries.description: Maps explicit historical revisionism and misrepresentation to the GCAM misinformation article.
entries.reviewerExplanation: Historical distortion or revisionism is mapped to the GCAM misinformation article.
entries.mappingNotes: Use for inaccurate historical framing, even when the text is styled as storytelling.
